name: exists_one_le_pow_mul_dist
statement: Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace R] {d : N → ℝ} {j : Z → N → R} {f : R → R} {α : R} {ε M : ℝ} -- denominators are positive (d0 : ∀ a : N, 1 ≤ d a) (e0 : 0 < ε) -- function is Lipschitz at α (B : ∀ ⦃y : R⦄, y ∈ closedBall α ε → dist (f α) (f y) ≤ dist α y * M) -- clear denominators (L : ∀ ⦃z : Z⦄, ∀ ⦃a : N⦄, j z a ∈ closedBall α ε → 1 ≤ d a * dist (f α) (f (j z a))) : ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ z : Z, ∀ a : N, 1 ≤ d a * (dist α (j z a) * A)

children.type: j z a ∈ closedBall α ε
